title: ElegantVLA: Learning When to Think for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models

tldr.en: A learned scheduler jointly selects perception-language reuse and action denoising modes; the base policy stays frozen.
tldr.zh: 学习调度器，联合选择感知语言复用与动作去噪模式，保持基座策略冻结。

evaluation_scope.en: GR00T/CogACT, SimplerEnv and six Franka tasks; RTX 4090. The scheduler is trained with the base policy frozen.
evaluation_scope.zh: GR00T/CogACT、SimplerEnv 与 6 项 Franka 真机任务；RTX 4090。基座策略冻结，调度器单独训练。
